description: O*NET tasks and DWAs that are outside the legal scope of practice in India for that occupation. They are excluded from scoring and shown as not_applicable_in_india with the reason, never as gaps or roadmap items. Only clear legal or scope-of-practice cases belong here; module 1 should eventually provide an india_relevant flag per requirement.

items.name: Prescribe or recommend drugs, medical devices, or other forms of treatment, such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
items.reason: Registered nurses in India do not have prescribing authority; prescriptions are written by registered medical practitioners.

items.name: Prescribe medications.

items.name: Prescribe assistive medical devices or related treatments.
items.reason: Registered nurses in India do not have prescribing authority; prescriptions are written by registered medical practitioners.

items.name: Prescribe medications.
items.reason: Pharmacists in India dispense against a registered medical practitioner's prescription; they do not prescribe (Pharmacy Practice Regulations, 2015).

items.name: Prescribe treatments or therapies.

items.name: Authorize drug refills and provide prescription information to pharmacies.
items.reason: In India a refill needs a registered medical practitioner's prescription; clinic or medical assistants cannot authorise one.
